def solution(items):
    """Returns the sum of the least common multiple of each adjacent pair in the list."""
    total = 0
    for i in range(len(items) - 1):
        a = items[i]
        b = items[i + 1]
        x, y = a, b
        while y:
            x, y = y, x % y
        g = x if x >= 0 else -x
        total += 0 if a == 0 or b == 0 else abs(a * b) // g
